summary: NIO Inc. filed a Form 6-K (the US-equivalent of a foreign private issuer's current report) furnishing a monthly delivery update for October 2026, not a special-situation event. The company reported 34,246 vehicles delivered in the month (18,125 NIO, 8,383 ONVO, 7,738 FIREFLY), 334,547 year-to-date, up 38.5% year-over-year, and cumulative deliveries of 1,332,139 as of October 31, 2026. No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisors, or deal mechanics are disclosed. The filing is a routine operational disclosure; there is no risk-arb angle to watch.
